name: final_horiz_dist
description: horizontal distance from pad center at the last step (m)

name: final_height
description: height above the pad at the last step (m)

name: touched_pad
description: 1.0 if the rocket ever contacted the landing pad, else 0.0

name: impact_vspeed
description: downward speed at first pad contact (m/s); 0 if never touched

name: clean_landing
description: 1.0 if it ended in an upright, near-zero-velocity touchdown

name: frac_hover_over_pad
description: fraction of steps hovering high (>5 m) but within 2 m of the pad

name: mean_descent_rate
description: mean downward speed over the trajectory (m/s, positive = descending)

name: mean_tilt
description: mean tilt from upright over the trajectory (rad)

name: max_tilt
description: peak tilt from upright reached at any step (rad)

name: mean_spin
description: mean absolute yaw rate over the trajectory (rad/s)

name: engine_on_frac
description: fraction of steps with the main engine ignited
